title: Glowing trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bell' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8C00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tube' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD84D'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FF9E00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E06D00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF7B0' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='36' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- bell flare -->
  <path d='M58 18 L86 8 Q96 50 86 84 L58 74 Q66 46 58 18 Z' fill='url(#bell)'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='46' rx='7' ry='38' fill='#FFD84D'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='31' fill='#C25E00' opacity='0.55'/>
  <path d='M86 8 Q96 50 86 84' fill='none' stroke='#FFE88A' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- main tube -->
  <rect x='26' y='40' width='34' height='12' rx='4' fill='url(#tube)'/>
  <rect x='27' y='41.5' width='32' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFF0A8' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- center valve casing + valves -->
  <rect x='40' y='26' width='10' height='30' rx='3' fill='#FFC21F'/>
  <rect x='41.5' y='27.5' width='2.5' height='27' rx='1' fill='#FFF3B8' opacity='0.75'/>
  <rect x='35' y='14' width='5' height='18' rx='2.5' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='14' r='4.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <rect x='54' y='20' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='20' r='4.5' fill='#FFE066'/>

  <!-- mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='16' y='42' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#E09600'/>
  <rect x='10' y='41' width='8' height='10' rx='4' fill='#FFC94D'/>
  <rect x='11.5' y='42.5' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFF3B8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- water key + brace -->
  <line x1='46' y1='52' x2='46' y2='60' stroke='#FF9E00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='62' r='3' fill='#FFC94D'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFF7B0'>
    <path d='M92 22 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M22 26 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 Z'/>
    <path d='M72 86 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
